description: This file contains various functions and logic for upgrading firmware on specific hardware platforms. It includes functions for device detection, backup, upgrade procedures for SD card boot, NOR flash, and platform-specific checks.

methods.name: platform_get_rootfs_device
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem device by inspecting /proc/self/mountinfo for the '/rom' mount point.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_sdboot
methods.description: Backs up configuration files to an SD card boot device.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_sdboot
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by extracting kernel and root filesystem to the SD card device.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nor
methods.description: Performs upgrade on NOR flash devices by combining kernel and root filesystem into a temporary image then flashing.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image against the device's board type and prepares the environment for upgrade.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data based on device type.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that chooses the appropriate upgrade method based on device type.
